messages:
emily-support: heads-up — customer CustCorp reported p99 API latency spike for requests hitting eu-west1 since ~2026-03-15 02:03 UTC. They see p95 ~400ms -> p99 ~5-8s. Example req id: req_9f3b2c. Curl timing attached.

vijay-oncall: thanks — can you paste the X-Request-ID + exact path + model? Also which POP (we route by client IP; maybe eu-west1)?

emily-support: req: 9f3b2c, path: POST /v1/generate, model:redwood-medium, client IP maps to eu-west1. Support ticket #5482 with HAR attached: https://redwood/support/5482

ana.sre: looking at traces — TLS handshake time is high on these reqs. sample from our edge logs:

```
edge_timestamp=2026-03-15T02:04:12Z req=req_9f3b2c tls_handshake_ms=480 total_time_ms=5020 route=euw1->pop-eu1 hop_count=7
```

ana.sre: running traceroute from eu-pop-eu1 to client IP now, getting extra AS hop (AS65200) in path

```
traceroute to 1.2.3.4 (1.2.3.4), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.4 ms 0.3 ms 0.3 ms
 2  192.0.2.1  1.2 ms 1.3 ms 1.2 ms
 3  * * *
 4  203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5)  45.2 ms 46.1 ms 48.0 ms  <-- AS65200
 5  1.2.3.4  46.9 ms 47.5 ms 47.2 ms
```

ingrid-net: we saw transient BGP updates with that peer around 02:00 UTC — update count on peering link increased from 2/min -> 120/min for ~8 minutes. Provider reported flaps. Filing peering ticket with AS65200.

patrick: mitigation suggestion — divert traffic for affected prefix to eu-central POP for 30m while peering gets sorted. Can do quick weight adjust on GSLB: `gwctl set-weight pop-eu1 0.0 pop-eu-central 1.0 --temp 1800`

vijay-oncall: +1. Make sure to keep sticky session rules for long poll clients. I'll run the change and monitor.

deploy-bot: executed: gwctl set-weight pop-eu1 0.0 pop-eu-central 1.0 --temp 1800 by vijay-oncall at 2026-03-15T02:12:35Z

vijay-oncall: monitoring dashboards — p99 for that customer dropped from 5.2s -> 680ms within 90s of change. TLS handshake times back to ~120ms.

emily-support: customer confirms improvement, says requests look normal now. I'll update ticket #5482 and close once stable.

ana.sre: follow-up actions: (1) postmortem to include peering flaps + AS65200, (2) automate temporary divert when per-prefix TLS handshake >300ms for >5min, (3) add probe alert to detect AS-level hop increase. I'll add to backlog.

patrick: also add docs for quick GSLB weight rollback and runbook for support to use during escalations. :thumbsup:

ingrid-net: filed peering ticket with provider (PT-9123). attaching BGP dump in ticket.

vijay-oncall: closing loop — will keep watch for 1h, ping here if we see recurrence.

emily-support: thanks team :clap:
